notes.subject: עוה עוה עוה
notes.rationale: Triple repetition of 'avah (ruin) — emphatic hammering, lost in single-word repetition in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: עד בא אשר לו המשפט
notes.rationale: 'Until he comes whose right/judgment it is' — famous crux: JPS reads the coming one (later read messianically, 'Shiloh' echo of Gen 49:10); KJV takes a different Hebrew text, rendering the verse about fuel for fire and being no more remembered.

notes.subject: ⟨i⟩
notes.rationale: Copula supplied in Tok Pisin for the relative clause 'whose is the judgment'.

notes.subject: עוה
notes.rationale: Rare interjection-like noun of ruin, repeated three times only here in this form.

translation: Bagarap, bagarap, bagarap — mi bai mekim ⟨את⟩ em; na dispela tu bai i no kamap, i go long taim man i kam bilong en ⟨i⟩ kot, na bai mi givim ⟨את⟩ em long em.
